caption: A promotional poster combines a soccer stadium scene on the left with a blue Citi-branded advertisement on the right. A male soccer player in a light blue jersey, black shorts, and black cleats is mid-kick, leg extended toward a ball, with bright stadium lights and a cheering crowd behind him. The right side says “Celebrate the game with Coca‑Cola” and highlights “up to 18.3% fuel savings” and “exclusive gifts at Esso.” A panel shows April: free Coca‑Cola 4-slim-can pack, and May: free 6 Coca‑Cola contour glasses, with a note to spend S$60 or more on fuel using a Citibank credit/debit card. Logos for Citi, Coca‑Cola, Cheers, FairPrice Xpress, and Esso appear at the bottom, along with small terms and conditions text.

The image shows a close-up of a person’s lower legs and feet against a pale green background. A large cardboard Burger King crown is wrapped around both calves like a band, with the Burger King logo visible multiple times. The person is wearing shiny red peep-toe high heels, and their toes are visible. The skin tone is light, and there are no other clothing items in view. In the bottom right corner, there is a plate of food featuring salad greens, diced grilled chicken, tomatoes, cheese chunks, and dressing. Next to the salad, colorful stylized text reads “check our new chicken salads,” with decorative white swirls beneath. The overall layout is clean with ample white space.

The image is a promotional poster for Dunkin’ Donuts titled “Flavor Radio! Special Radio Advertisement Releasing a Coffee Aroma Via Sound Recognition Technology.” It explains a campaign in Seoul to associate Dunkin’ with coffee. Graphics show a bus broadcasting a radio ad, a sound recognition machine detecting the Dunkin’ jingle, and an automatic spray releasing coffee aroma, leading commuters to visit a Dunkin’ store. A results panel displays icons indicating a 16% visitor increase and 29% sales increase. Text sections labeled Background & Mission, Idea, and Result describe the concept. Photos at the bottom show a hot coffee cup, equipment, buses, people, and store exteriors. Icons, arrows, and diagrams illustrate the process.

A bold red advertisement features a large photo of a salad in a bowl on the right, filled with greens, grilled chicken strips, corn, black beans, shredded cheese, tortilla strips, and lime wedges. Black, swirling graphic shapes surround the bowl. On the left, yellow text reads “A Taste That Inspires” with three bullet points, each with a checkmark box: “New Trail,” “New Gear,” and “New Salad.” Below the list, a person in running attire, seen from the back, runs along a stylized trail. Background elements include subtle icons of hiking and cycling, a small bird illustration, a rose graphic, and a pocket watch drawing. At the bottom right are the words “The New Southwest Salad.” and a yellow McDonald’s logo with “i’m lovin’ it.”

The image features a polished advertisement-style scene with three blue Pepsi cans arranged against a dark blue gradient background. The central can stands in front, flanked by two slightly behind it, all showing the red, white, and blue Pepsi globe logo and the word “pepsi” in white type running vertically. Dynamic water splashes arc around the cans, with droplets frozen midair, suggesting cold refreshment. Reflections of the cans and water appear subtly on the glossy surface beneath them. At the bottom center, small white text reads “REFRESH YOUR WORLD pepsi.” No people are present, and the composition is clean and symmetrical, emphasizing the product and the sense of motion created by the splashing water.

An advertisement shows a clear plastic bottle labeled “ethos WATER” tilted on its side at the upper left, with its cap area open and light blue water pouring out. The splash forms a large heart shape on the right side of the image against a white background, with scattered droplets around the stream. A small green circular logo with a mermaid-like figure appears in the top right corner. At the bottom, bold black text reads, “Your sip, their survival.” Below it, smaller paragraphs explain that more than 800 million people need clean water and that buying a bottle contributes 5 cents to a water fund, encouraging customers to be part of the change.

A Coca‑Cola advertisement features two hands clinking chilled glass Coke bottles in the right half of the image, with droplets and fizz visible around the openings. Each bottle has a red label printed with a large white first name: “Kylie” on the left bottle and “Luke” on the right bottle. On the left side, large text reads “Share a Coke with a friend,” followed by smaller lines encouraging contact with a good, old, or new friend, and the web address “shareacoke.com.au.” The Coca‑Cola logo with the phrase “open happiness” appears in the top right corner. The background is clean white with a light gradient, emphasizing the bottles and text.

The image shows a minimalist advertisement on a white background featuring a bright red tomato with a green stem beside a tall wedge of pale yellow cheese. To the left of the food items, small green text explains that Dunkin Donuts is offering more than morning donuts and now provides personal pizzas made to order. Near the bottom center, the Dunkin’ Donuts logo appears in orange and pink with the tagline “more than coffee and donuts.” A thin line of fine print at the very bottom lists participating states. There are no people present, and the composition emphasizes the fresh tomato and cheese as simple pizza ingredients against ample empty space.

A promotional graphic showcases the historical timeline of the McDonald’s menu in the USA. Centered at the top is large red and white text reading “The Historical Timeline of the McDonald’s Menu in the USA,” layered over a gray banner and backed by a faint yellow double-arch logo. The foreground displays an assortment of McDonald’s food items arranged in a row: a parfait with granola, breaded chicken pieces, a barbecue-style rib sandwich, a sesame-seed burger, a fish sandwich with cheese, a fresh salad in a black bowl, a breakfast wrap filled with eggs and meat, and two cartons of French fries. The background is light gray with subtle vertical text referencing menu items. No people are present.

A fast-food advertisement features a yellow background with large red text reading “COME BACK and SHAKE UP YOUR WAKE UP.” The Burger King logo appears in the top right corner. Centered is a black bowl filled with a breakfast mix of scrambled eggs, diced potatoes, bell peppers in green and red, sausage pieces, and drizzled cheese or sauce. To the right of the bowl is an English muffin breakfast sandwich with egg, cheese, and a sausage patty. Text at the bottom left says “New BK Breakfast Bowl,” and at the bottom right says “New BK Breakfast Muffin Sandwich.” Small fine print along the lower edge notes price and participation may vary and availability during breakfast hours only, with a 2010 copyright.

A bright blue background features a chilled can of Pepsi positioned on the right side. The dark navy can is covered with water droplets and shows the circular Pepsi logo with red, white, and blue waves, plus the word “pepsi” printed vertically in white. The can sits on a subtle shadow, suggesting a surface. On the left, large bold white letters tilt diagonally, reading “REFRESH YOUR WORLD.” The text is clean and graphic, occupying much of the space. There are no people present, and the composition emphasizes the beverage can and the slogan against the uniform blue backdrop, creating a simple, high-contrast advertisement-style scene.

A promotional image shows a white disposable coffee cup with a lid on a wooden table at left. The cup bears a green circular logo that reads “Starbucks Coffee,” with checkboxes printed vertically along the side and small caution text near the bottom. The background is softly blurred in warm tones, suggesting an indoor café setting with lights and indistinct shapes. On the right, large white text states “The best coffee For the best YOU.” with “YOU.” in dark green. Below that, a cursive white tagline reads “Taste of Inspiration.” The composition highlights the cup in the foreground and the bold promotional message against the warm, unfocused backdrop. No people are clearly visible.

The image is a bright red Coca‑Cola advertisement featuring two smiling adults seated close together, each holding a classic glass Coca‑Cola bottle with visible labels. They appear to be laughing and looking down, with their heads nearly touching. The person on the left wears a gray shirt with a white undershirt and a watch, while the person on the right wears a plaid shirt and a bracelet. White bubble graphics float above them on the red background. Large white text on the right reads “happiness. coca-cola.” The top‑right corner shows the Coca‑Cola logo, and a hashtag “#openhappiness” is printed below it. A QR code and small text are placed in the lower right corner.

The image shows a minimalist advertisement featuring a transparent burger-shaped object made of clear glass or water-like material, set against a smooth blue gradient background. Inside the rounded top and bottom “bun” layers, a small orange goldfish is visible swimming, with its body centered and tail extending downward. Between the layers, a glossy wedge resembling a slice of ice or cheese appears, also transparent. At the top, white text reads “Filet-O-Fish®.” In the lower right corner, a red square contains a yellow double-arched logo and the phrase “i’m lovin’ it.” The scene is brightly lit, with reflections and highlights emphasizing the glassy surfaces and the fish’s vivid color. No people are present.

The image is a Dunkin’ Donuts advertisement with a light green background and large white text at the top left reading “MAKES OTHER SNACKS LOOK SCARY.” At the center, snack pieces shaped like cheese puffs are arranged to resemble a spider, with a round puff as the body and multiple elongated puffs forming legs. The spider-like arrangement casts soft shadows on the surface. In the lower right corner, a yellow smoothie in a clear cup is shown, labeled “Dunkin’ Donuts Smoothie” with a small fruit graphic and the word “Tropicana” on the lid rim area. Along the bottom margin, small text mentions real fruit, vitamin C, low fat yogurt, and the slogan “America Runs on Dunkin’.” No people are visible.

A blue-themed advertisement shows a single Pepsi can centered against a dark-to-light blue gradient background. The can features the classic red, white, and blue Pepsi globe logo with the word “PEPSI” beneath it, printed on a patterned blue design. Water droplets and small splashes surround the can, suggesting cold refreshment, and a faint reflection or shadow appears on the surface below it. There are no people visible. At the bottom of the image, small white text reads “every PEPSI refreshes the world,” with the brand name in a bold rectangular mark. The overall scene is clean, minimal, and focused on the beverage can and its watery effect.

The image is an advertisement featuring a large, close-up hamburger on a reddish gradient background. The burger has a sesame seed bun, leafy green lettuce, thick tomato slices, white onion rings, pickles, bacon, melted cheese, and a grilled beef patty, with juices visible near the bottom bun. At the top, bold white text reads “BURRRGERRR KING.” In the lower right corner, there is a small Burger King logo next to a white silhouette resembling a statue on a pedestal. Near the bottom center-right, smaller text in Portuguese says “AGORA COM SOTAQUE CARIOCA.” The burger is centered and well lit, with a shadow and reflection beneath it, giving the food a glossy, appetizing appearance.

A dark, minimalist advertisement features a glowing cup of coffee on the left and large white text on the right. The coffee is in a transparent glass cup with a handle, filled with a bright, golden liquid that radiates light, with sparks or particles rising upward like steam. The background is nearly black, creating strong contrast with the illuminated drink and text. The words BUY ME A COFFEE appear in bold, three‑dimensional white letters across the right side. In the bottom left corner, the circular Starbucks Coffee logo is visible, and along the bottom edge the slogan STARBUCKS. REAL COFFEE. is printed in bold white capital letters. No people are present.

A bright red Coca‑Cola advertisement shows a smiling young woman from the waist up on the left side, wearing a white top and long dark hair. She holds a cold, sweating glass bottle of Coca‑Cola in her right hand, with condensation droplets and a red label clearly visible. Large white text on the right reads “perfection,” with smaller Spanish text “perfección helada” beneath it, and yellow words “ice cold” nearby. A circular Coca‑Cola logo appears in the upper left. The lower part of the image features a bed of ice cubes, emphasizing the drink’s chill. At the bottom left are small white credits including “JP/2011” and a blogspot address.

The image is a minimalist advertisement featuring a single, detailed strip of cooked bacon placed diagonally across a large white background. Below the bacon, red text explains that Dunkin Donuts offers more than morning donuts, highlighting new breakfast sandwiches and the option to include bacon. Near the bottom right, the Dunkin’ Donuts logo appears in orange and pink beside the tagline “more than coffee and donuts.” Very small gray text along the bottom lists participating states. There are no people, only the bacon slice and text elements. The overall layout is clean with ample white space, drawing attention to the bacon as the central object and the promotional message.

A bold red poster shows three bursts resembling fireworks, each cleverly composed of golden French fries arranged like exploding sparks. The fries are evenly lit, with shadows and highlights giving them a crisp texture against the smooth gradient background that darkens toward the top corners. There are no people present. Centered near the bottom is a white line of text reading “CELEBRATING CANNES CREATIVE MARKETER OF THE YEAR.” Below the text sit two small logos: a white cursive “Leo Burnett” signature on the left and a yellow McDonald’s Golden Arches icon on the right. The overall layout is clean, with ample negative space emphasizing the fry “fireworks.”

A colorful advertisement shows a woman in a bright blue dress holding a silver can of Diet Pepsi with condensation and a striped red‑white‑blue straw. She tilts the can toward her red lips as if about to sip, wearing red nail polish and earrings, with long wavy brown hair over her shoulders. The background is a smooth light blue gradient. To the right, large text in Spanish reads “prueba el gran sabor de diet pepsi” with the Pepsi logo and a Splenda logo beneath it. At the bottom right sits another Diet Pepsi can marked with red lipstick kiss prints, next to the phrase “más sexy que nunca.” A small Facebook icon and handle appear below.

A promotional poster features a large white fabric panel with coffee beans arranged as raised dots forming braille across the top. At the bottom left, brown text in Portuguese reads “Novos cardápios em braille Starbucks,” and the green Starbucks siren logo appears at the lower right. On the right side of the poster, the title “Coffee Braille” is followed by short sections labeled “Challenge” and “Solution,” explaining the concept in English. Three small photos show close-ups of coffee beans forming braille, a person pointing toward the large braille panel mounted on a wall inside a cafe, and a hand touching the bean dots. A brown strip runs along the top edge of the fabric panel. The overall design is clean and minimal.

A promotional image shows a close-up of a hamburger with a black, sesame-seeded bun set against a dark background. The burger features layers of green leaf lettuce, thick tomato slices, white onion rings, melted yellow cheese, and a beef patty, with reddish-brown sauce visible between the ingredients and dripping slightly. The sandwich sits on a rough, dark wooden surface with parchment paper. To the right, two bottles labeled “A1” lie on their sides, one open with sauce pooled near the mouth. Large white text reads “Halloween Whopper,” with smaller text stating “A1 flavor baked into the bun.” No people are visible in the scene.

The image is a Coca‑Cola advertisement with a solid red background. Four classic glass Coke bottles stand side by side on the left half: from left to right they are Coca‑Cola with a red label, Coca‑Cola Life with a green label marked “lower calories,” Coca‑Cola Zero with a black label reading “zero calories,” and Diet Coke with a silver label marked “no calories.” Each bottle is filled with dark soda and condensation droplets. On the right side, large white text states “Good things come in fours.” Near the bottom right corner, smaller text reads “choose happiness,” accompanied by tiny silhouettes of the four bottle colors. No people are visible.

A minimalist advertisement features a bright red background with a stylized Wi‑Fi symbol made from four golden French fries arranged as curved bars. The fries are centered slightly above the middle of the image, each piece shorter than the one above it, mimicking the familiar wireless icon. There are no people, buildings, or additional objects besides the fries and branding. In the lower right corner, a small yellow McDonald’s “M” logo appears above the words “love free wi‑fi,” with “love” and “wi‑fi” in yellow and “free” in white. The overall composition is clean, with ample negative space highlighting the playful food‑based Wi‑Fi motif and the brand’s message.

The image is a colorful advertisement on a warm yellow background promoting discounted donuts. At the top, large white-and-pink letters read, “YOU CAN’T PUT A PRICE ON HAPPINESS.” Centered below is a large silver U.S. quarter with the profile of George Washington; a donut with chocolate icing and multicolored sprinkles overlaps the coin, and a bite through both creates a matching circular hole where the coin’s center would be. A soft drop shadow grounds the donut and coin. Near the bottom, bold orange text says, “BUT 25 CENT DONUTS HELP.” Smaller white text mentions tough times and invites people on October 25th for 25 cent donuts. In the lower right are small icons and the Dunkin’ logo. No people are present.

The image is a colorful advertisement featuring a large paper cup filled with a dark, fizzy soda and ice. The cup is decorated in blue, white, and red with the Pepsi globe logo and the word “pepsi” printed vertically. Water droplets cover the cup, and carbonated bubbles and splashes appear above the drink, emphasizing refreshment. The background is diagonally split into red at the top left and blue at the bottom right, with a white wave separating them and additional splash effects along the divide. Bold white text on the right reads “ENJOY A PEPSI,” and smaller text at the bottom says “LIVE FOR NOW” with the Pepsi globe used as the letter “O.” No people are visible.

A promotional poster showcases Starbucks seasonal blends arranged in a four-panel grid around the Starbucks siren logo at center. Each quadrant features a clear glass mug of a different latte-style drink topped with whipped cream or caramel. The top left drink has whipped cream drizzled with caramel; the top right has whipped cream sprinkled with small chocolate pieces. The bottom left shows a latte with a caramel lattice design on foam, next to caramel candies. The bottom right presents a creamy beverage with a generous swirl of whipped cream dusted with spice. A green banner reads “Starbucks Seasonal Blends” at the top, and along the center it says, “The perfect blend for your favorite show… and any other occasion.” The word “Advertisement” appears in the bottom corner.

The image shows a clean, pale background with a whimsical stack of five clay cows balanced vertically in the center-left. Each cow is white with black spots, peach-colored muzzles and hooves, and expressive cartoon faces. The bottom cow braces with a strained grin, while the others wobble in different poses, some with raised legs or flailing arms. Their glossy surfaces create soft reflections on the floor beneath them. On the lower right, a small clay emblem resembling a burger-shaped logo in red, yellow, and blue sits next to brown clay letters spelling “BK STICKER.” The arrangement suggests playful, handcrafted figures displayed like a tower, with ample empty space surrounding the scene.

A digital tabletop game interface for UNO is displayed on a wooden background. Four players labeled Player 0, Player 1, Player 2, and Player 3 sit at the bottom, left, top, and right with circular avatar icons showing a generic silhouette. Each has a “UNORULEAGENT” tag and a “Hand Size” panel with face‑down cards; Player 2’s panel shows “+4” and Player 3’s shows “+4.” At center, the “Played Cards” and “Target Card” both show a red 4, while a “Deck Size” pile indicates 76 cards. A “Direction 1” label appears above. Player 0’s hand is visible: green 7, yellow 4, blue 1, yellow Reverse, Wild Draw 4, and green Reverse. The word UNO is etched on the table at center.

The image shows a digital tabletop interface for a game of UNO presented on a wooden background. Four players are arranged around the table: Player 0 at the bottom with their five-card hand visible, including a green 7, blue 1, yellow 0, a Wild Draw 4, and a green Reverse. Player 1, Player 2, and Player 3 appear at left, top, and right with face‑down hands and small avatar icons; each shows a “UNORULEAGENT” label and a hand-size indicator “+3.” At the center, a row of played cards displays red 4, yellow 4, green 4, green 3, and green 7. The current target card is a green 7, and the deck size is shown as 76. The word UNO is printed on the tabletop.

A digital tabletop shows an UNO card game interface on a wood background. Four players labeled Player 0, Player 1, Player 2, and Player 3 appear as circular avatars with generic silhouettes and “UNORULEAGENT” under each. At the bottom, Player 0’s open hand displays five cards: Blue 1, Yellow Reverse, Yellow 9, Wild Draw 4, and Green Reverse, plus a vertical Green card. Center left, a Played Cards strip shows Red 4, Yellow 4, Green 4, Green 3, Green 7, Green 7, Green 2, and Green 6, next to two vertical black Wild cards. Center right, the Target Card shows a vertical black Wild. A Deck Size pile indicates +76. Hand Size piles for Players 1–3 show facedown stacks with “+2.” Direction displays “1.”

The image shows a digital tabletop interface for a game of Uno on a wooden background. Four circular avatar icons labeled Player 0, Player 1, Player 2, and Player 3 are arranged around the screen, with “UNORULEAGENT” under each name. At the bottom, Player 0’s hand is visible, showing a blue 1, a yellow Reverse, a yellow 0, and a black Wild Draw 4. At center-left, a spread of recently played cards includes red 4, yellow 4, green 4, green 3, green 7, green 7, green 2, and green 6, plus a black Wild and two yellow Reverse cards. To the right, a yellow Target Card displays 3 and YELLOW. Deck Size shows a face-down stack with “+74.” Hand size boxes indicate +1 for Player 1 and +2 for Players 2 and 3. The word UNO is printed on the wood.

The image shows a digital tabletop interface for a game of Uno on a wooden background labeled “UNO” at the center. Four players are positioned around the table: Player 0 at the bottom with three visible cards (Blue 1, Blue Reverse, and a black Wild Draw). Player 1 is on the left, Player 2 at the top, and Player 3 on the right, each represented by a circular avatar and a facedown hand with a small “+” number indicating card count changes. At the center-left is a “Played Cards” panel displaying a sequence of previously played cards in red, yellow, and green, plus Wild and Reverse cards. The “Target Card” shows Yellow 4. To the right is the draw deck with a count, and a “Direction” indicator shows 1.

The image shows a digital tabletop UNO game interface with a wood texture background and “UNO” printed at the center. Four players are positioned around the table: Player 0 at the bottom with two blue cards (a blue 1 and a blue Reverse) visible, Player 1 on the left with a facedown hand of six cards, Player 2 at the top with a facedown hand of two cards, and Player 3 on the right with a facedown hand of four cards. In the middle-left, a history of played cards is stacked, including red 4, several greens, yellows, a Wild, a Reverse, and a Wild Draw 4. The current target card is a blue 2. A deck stack appears to the right labeled with +68 cards. A small “Direction 1” indicator is near the center.

A digital tabletop scene shows a virtual UNO game on a wood-grain surface. Four players are positioned around the table as icons labeled Player 0, Player 1, Player 2, and Player 3, each with “UNORULEAGENT” under the name. Player 0 at the bottom has one blue “1” card in hand. At the center, a stack of recently played cards displays colors and actions, including red 4, yellow 4, several green numbers, blue 2s, reverses, a Wild, and a Wild Draw 4. To the right, the target card is a blue 2 and the deck shows +67 remaining. Hand size panels indicate extra cards for the other players, and a “Direction -1” marker appears above the played cards. The word UNO is etched on the tabletop.

A digital UNO game interface is displayed on a wooden table background. Four players are labeled Player 0, Player 1, Player 2, and Player 3, each with a circular avatar icon and a payoff score beneath their name. Player 1’s hand is shown at the top with cards including red 5 and 9, blue Skip, green 4, a Wild, blue 6, and yellow 9. At center, a stack of played cards shows colors and actions such as Reverse, Wild Draw 4, and numbers. The current target card on the right is a blue 1. Player 2’s hand on the right shows red 3, yellow 1, yellow 6, and red 3. Player 3’s hand at the bottom includes Skip, red 9 and 0, and blue 6. The word UNO appears in the table center.

A digital tabletop interface shows a game of UNO on a wood-textured background. Four players are arranged around the screen as Player 0 at left, Player 2 at top, Player 3 at right, and Player 1 at bottom, each with a circular avatar and the label “UNORULEAGENT.” Player 1’s hand is visible with seven cards: Red 5, Yellow Reverse, Blue 5, Blue 2, Green 2, Green 4, and Blue Skip 2. The center displays “UNO” and a panel with “Played Cards” showing a Red 4 and a Yellow 4, the “Target Card” as Yellow 4, and a “Deck Size” pile with +76. Each other player has a face-down hand with a small +number indicating hand size. Direction is marked as 1.

A digital tabletop UNO game screen is shown on a wooden background. The center displays the discard pile labeled Played Cards with a sequence: red 4, yellow 4, green 4, green 3, green 7, green 7. The current Target Card is a green 7. To the right is a Deck Size area with a face‑down stack and a small +76 indicator. Four circular avatars labeled Player 0, Player 1, Player 2, and Player 3 sit around the table with “UNORULEAGENT” under each name and hand size panels near them: Player 0 +2, Player 2 +3, Player 3 +3. At the bottom, Player 1’s visible hand shows five cards: red 5, red Reverse, yellow 5, blue 2, and a blue Skip. The word UNO is printed faintly on the wood.

A digital tabletop interface shows a game of Uno on a wood-grain background. Four players are positioned around the edges as icons labeled Player 0, Player 1, Player 2, and Player 3, each with a “UNORULEAGENT” tag and a hand-size display using facedown cards. Player 1’s hand is visible at the bottom, holding four cards: red 5, yellow Reverse, blue 5, and blue Skip 2. At center, a horizontal row lists previously played cards, mostly green numbers plus a green Reverse and a Wild. To the right sits the current target card, a green Reverse, and a deck of facedown cards labeled +74. A “Direction -1” indicator appears above the center, and the word UNO is printed on the virtual table.

A digital tabletop interface shows a game of Uno on a wood-grain background. Four players are arranged around the screen as icons labeled Player 0, Player 1, Player 2, and Player 3, each with a face silhouette avatar and a hand size display; Players 2 and 3 have a small “+2” beside their hand size. At the bottom, Player 1’s visible hand contains three cards: red 5, blue 5, and a blue Skip 2. At center-left, a pile of played cards fans out, including numbers and actions in red, yellow, green, and a black Wild and Reverse. A small panel indicates Target Card “0 YELLOW.” To the right, a deck stack shows “+74.” The word UNO is printed on the virtual table.

A digital tabletop shows an UNO game on a wooden surface. Four player spots are arranged around the edges, labeled Player 0, Player 1, Player 2, and Player 3, each with a small avatar icon and “UNORULEAGENT” under the name. Player 1’s hand is visible at the bottom, displaying blue 6, blue 1, green 4, red 9, red 2, red 5, blue Skip, blue 5, and a separate yellow 9. The center-left “Played Cards” stack shows a history of colors and actions, including Wild, Wild Draw 4, Reverse, and various numbers. The current target card at center-right is a blue 1. A deck pile with “+67” appears near it. Hand-size cards for Players 2 and 3 show “+1,” and direction displays “-1.” The UNO logo is printed in the middle.

The image shows a digital tabletop interface for a game of UNO on a wooden background. Four players are arranged around the edges: Player 1 at the top, Player 0 at left, Player 3 at right, and Player 2 at the bottom. Each player has a small circular avatar and a label reading UNORULEAGENT; hand sizes for Players 0, 1, and 3 are displayed as face‑down cards with +3 or +4 markers. At center are panels for Played Cards, Target Card, and Deck Size. Played Cards show three number 4 cards in red, yellow, and green. The Target Card is a green 4. The deck shows a large face‑down stack with +76. Player 2’s visible hand includes yellow 5 and 7, green 3 and 6, red 3 and 1, and yellow 6. The word UNO is printed on the wood.

The image shows a digital tabletop interface for a game of Uno on a wooden background. Four players are arranged around the edges: Player 1 at the top, Player 0 at left, Player 3 at right, and Player 2 at the bottom, each with a small avatar silhouette and the label “UNORULEAGENT.” Face-down hand cards are shown for Players 0, 1, and 3 with small +2 or +3 counters. Player 2’s hand is visible: yellow 5, green 6, red 3, red 1, yellow 6, red 1, and yellow 7. In the center are “Played Cards” showing a sequence ending with several green numbers, the current “Target Card” is green 2, and a face-down deck displays “+76.” The word “UNO” is printed on the table. Direction indicates 1.

The image shows a digital tabletop interface for a game of UNO on a wooden background. Four players are arranged around the edges: Player 0 at left, Player 1 at top, Player 3 at right, and Player 2 at bottom, each represented by a generic avatar and cards shown as face‑down stacks with hand sizes indicated by small +numbers. At the center, a sequence of “Played Cards” is visible, mostly green numbers 4, 3, 7, 7, 2, 6, preceded by a red 4 and a yellow 4, with a black Wild and a green Reverse overlapping. The “Target Card” is green Reverse. A “Deck Size” pile shows many face‑down cards marked +75. Player 2’s hand is visible: yellow 5, red 3, red 1, red 6, yellow 7. The word UNO is printed on the wood.

A digital tabletop interface shows a game of Uno on a wood-grain background. Four circular avatars labeled Player 0, Player 1, Player 2, and Player 3 sit around the table with “UNORULEAGENT” under each. At the bottom, Player 2’s open hand is visible: yellow 5, yellow 3, red 1, red 6, yellow 7, and red 3. The center-left “Played Cards” row shows previous cards including red 4, yellow 4, green 4, green 3, green 7, green 2, and green 6, plus a black Wild and two yellow Reverse cards. The current “Target Card” is a yellow Reverse. A deck stack labeled +74 sits to the right. Hand-size panels appear near Players 0, 1, and 3, and “UNO” is printed on the table.

The image shows a digital tabletop interface for the card game UNO on a wood-grain background. Four player icons labeled Player 0, Player 1, Player 2, and Player 3 appear around the screen with “UNORULEAGENT” under each. Player 2’s hand is visible at the bottom: five red cards with numbers 3, 1, 6, 7, and 3. At the center-left is a “Played Cards” stack displaying several colored cards, including a black Wild, yellow Reverse, and a series of red, yellow, and green number cards. A small panel labeled Target Card shows “0 YELLOW.” The deck size panel indicates +73. Hand size placeholders for the other players show face-down cards, and a “Direction 1” label appears near the middle.
